text: Datasets included JMP database include: Censuses, principle collect basic data people living within country. Censuses always led national statistical offices. Household surveys, collect data subset households. may target national, rural, urban populations, limited project sub-national areas. appropriate sample design necessary survey results representative, surveys often led reviewed approved national statistical organizations. Administrative data, may consist information collected government non-government entities involved delivery oversight services. Examples include: water sanitation inventories databases, reports regulators. datasets may available compilations international regional initiatives (e.g. IB-NET), studies conducted research institutes, technical advice received country consultations.

%>%     arrange(desc(n)) ## # A tibble: 631 × 3 ##    type                      source     n ##    <chr>                     <chr>  <int> ##  1 Survey with microdata     MICS    1712 ##  2 Admin interface    16055 ## 4 containment         295 ## 5 emptying           2601 ## 6 transport           664 ## 7 FS treatment        125 ## 8 WW treatment       1375 jmpraw %>%     ggplot(aes(x = year, fill = type)) +     geom_bar() jmpraw %>%     ggplot(aes(x = year, fill = san_service_chain)) +     geom_bar() jmpraw %>%     filter(!is.na(san_service_chain)) %>%     group_by(san_service_chain) %>% and since 2000"     ) +     theme_minimal() jmpraw %>%     filter(!is.na(san_service_chain)) %>%     count(san_service_chain) %>%     mutate(         prop = n / sum(n) * 100     ) %>%      ggplot(aes(x = san_service_chain, y = prop)) +     geom_col() +     labs(         title = "Proportion of data sources along sanitation service chain",         subtitle = "For 232 countries and since 2000"     ) jmpraw %>%     filter(!is.na(san_service_chain)) %>%     count(year, san_service_chain) %>%     group_by(year) %>%     mutate(         prop = n / sum(n) * 100     ) %>%      ggplot(aes(x = year, y = prop, fill = san_service_chain)) +     geom_col() +     labs(         x = NULL,         y = NULL,         title = "Proportion of data points along collected variables",         subtitle = "For all countries since 2000",         fill = "Variable"     ) +     scale_fill_brewer(palette = "BrBG") +     theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +     theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) jmp_iso3_frequency <- jmpraw %>%     count(iso3)  jmp_iso3_user_interface_2015 <- jmpraw %>%     filter(year >= 2015) %>%     filter(san_service_chain == "user interface") %>%     count(iso3, san_service_chain)  jmp_iso3_emptying_2015 <- jmpraw %>%     filter(year >= 2015) %>%     filter(san_service_chain == "emptying") %>%     count(iso3, san_service_chain)  jmp_iso3_ww_treatment_2015 <- jmpraw %>%     filter(year >= 2015) %>%     filter(san_service_chain == "WW treatment") %>%     count(iso3, san_service_chain)  jmp_iso3_fs_treatment_2015 <- jmpraw %>%     filter(year >= 2015) %>%     filter(san_service_chain == "FS treatment") %>%     count(iso3, san_service_chain)
